Introduction

Welcome to the user manual for the Special Projects module in Odoo ERP

system!

This manual is your comprehensive guide to effectively managing and
overseeing special projects within our organization. Special projects typically
involve unique initiatives that require detailed planning, resource allocation,
and meticulous execution over extended periods. For any type of project, this
guide provides step-by-step instructions and functional guidance on utilizing
the ERP system to streamline project workflows. From project setup and management
to budget tracking, and comprehensive reporting, empower yourself with the
tools and knowledge needed to optimize project management processes and achieve
successful outcomes. Whether you're a project manager, team member, or
administrator, this manual equips you with the essential skills to navigate and
leverage the Special Projects module effectively.

Updating the

costs of items in project quotations, from RFQs.

In the project quotation, when the quotation lines are added, the field
“Cost Value” gets updated with the current average cost of each item that are
already available in the inventory. For items that are not available or new,
the Cost Value is updated as zero. Therefore the latest cost is retrieved using
the RFQs that was explained above. Once the RFQs are finalized the cost of each
RFQ line can be retrieved to the project quotation lines using the button UPDATE RFQ COST in the project

quotation form.

In case of an import RFQ: the cost value will be the sum of the unit price in local currency +
the total allocated charges, duties, and taxes of each item. [Cost = (Unit Price x Customer

Exchange rate in RFQ) + Allocated Charges].

For Local RFQ: The cost value will

be the unit price in the RFQ.

Note: To use the 'UPDATE RFQ COST' option in project quotations,
ensure that the RFQs covering all the PR lines have been updated and finalized

using the 'UPDATE PR' button.

Creating a new Staging branch from Github Repo

Setup Guide:

1. Login to github and navigate to JinStage repo.

2. Create a new branch by clicking on ""Branches"" and then click on ""New Branch"".

3. Enter a name for the branch and click ""Create new branch"".

4. After creating the new empty branch. Navigate back to Odoo.sh
column2:
and click the plus icon next to ""Development"" and select the newly created branch in the fork dropdown.

5. Once the development build is created. Click on the settings tab and select the required version. when selected the build will be rebuild with a fresh DB.

6. After rebuilding with the required version click on the builds tab and navigate to the newly created build and click on the 3 dots icon and click on ""Download DB Dump"" from the drop down list.

7. Next head back to the branches page and click on the plus icon next to Staging. Select the newly created development build in the Fork dropdown list and create a Staging build.

8. The build will most likely fail due to version conflict. Click on the ""Backups"" tab and click import Database button.

9. Click on ""Choose file"" button and select the Database Dump previously downloaded. Once the DB dump has been uploaded the build will be rebuilt to the version of the DB dump and can be accessed normally through Odoo.sh.

Additional Note

After restoring the DB if the icons don't appear like the screenshot below. Enter the shell and run the command odoo-update all
